text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Arima Kinen has finally arrived. Hordes of spectators have come to witness the decisive battle between Narita Brian and Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian reflects on when we met and the time we've spent together. It seems her hunger has been satisfied at least a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The curtain at last rises on the year's biggest stage—the Arima Kinen!
